confirm.description:
The serial port of the Global Caché IP2SL of {title} is set to {baudrate} baud, {flow_control}, {parity}. The Seymour controller needs 115200 baud, no flow control, and no parity, so it can't understand the IP2SL. A factory reset of the IP2SL sets 9600 baud.

Select **Submit** to change the settings of the IP2SL.
confirm.title: The IP2SL of {title} has the wrong serial settings

ip2sl_serial_settings.title: The IP2SL of {title} has the wrong serial settings

no_response.description:
Home Assistant can connect to the Seymour controller of {title}, but the controller doesn't answer. It keeps trying in the background.

To fix this:
1. Check that the controller is powered on.
2. Check the serial cable between the controller and Home Assistant, or the Global Caché IP2SL.
3. With an IP2SL, check that its serial port is set to 115200 baud, no flow control, and no parity. A factory reset of the IP2SL changes it to 9600 baud.
4. With an IP2SL, power-cycle it. After Home Assistant lost power or its network, the IP2SL can keep holding the old connection, and it allows only one.

This issue disappears once the controller answers again.
no_response.title: {title} doesn't respond

unreachable.description:
Home Assistant can't reach the Seymour controller of {title}. It keeps trying in the background.

To fix this:
1. Check that the controller is powered on.
2. Check the serial cable between the controller and Home Assistant, or the network connection of the Global Caché IP2SL.
3. If the controller moved to another serial port or address, reconfigure the integration.

This issue disappears once the controller answers again.
